stories.title: Flock is catching flak. Experts say other surveillance tools are more worrisome
stories.summary: AI-powered surveillance tools like Flock cameras have gotten a lot of media attention and public criticism, but there are many other lesser-known tools being deployed by local police departments.

stories.title: Margaret Hamilton, whose software sent humans to the moon, dies at 90
stories.summary: Margaret Hamilton, the computing pioneer whose work helped put humans on the moon, has died at 90. She is also credited with formalizing the discipline of software engineering.

stories.title: Study finds 194-year-old tortoise is 'aging more slowly than you would expect'
stories.summary: Researchers are studying the genome of the world's oldest land animal — a 194-year-old tortoise named Jonathan — to uncover secrets about his longevity.

stories.title: The USS Abraham Lincoln is home in San Diego, after a record deployment
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Rep. Sara Jacobs, D-Calif., about the return of the USS Abraham Lincoln, after some 11 months away from its home base in San Diego, including support in the Iran War.

stories.title: ICE has quietly used this warehouse as a detention facility all summer, neighbors say
stories.summary: Throughout the summer, rumors have been bubbling in North New Jersey that ICE has quietly been using a warehouse as a detention center. NPR investigated.

stories.title: Major news outlets and Trump administration return to court over White House ban
stories.summary: Three major news outlets were back in court Thursday to convince a judge the White House is violating their constitutional rights by continuing to block their access to the president.
